# Massive MIMO CSI Dataset for Next-Generation Networks

A simulated massive-MIMO CSI dataset with stationary, high-speed mobility, and urban-macro scenarios, including 3GPP-based channel profiles with noise and Doppler effects for CSI prediction and related AI/ML studies.
